settings.heading: How it ships
settings.text: Packed at our Ventura, CA location and shipped Monday through Wednesday so packages aren't held in carrier facilities over the weekend. Shipping is calculated at checkout and is free on orders over $100. See our Shipping Policy.

settings.heading: Age verification
settings.text: Every order requires an adult 21 or older with valid government-issued ID to sign at delivery. Carriers will not leave beer unattended.
